classification_contract.follow_rule: If neither agent collides, classify follow when final seam-safe unwrapped ego-minus-opponent progress is less than or equal to zero.
classification_contract.overtake_rule: If neither agent collides, classify overtake when final seam-safe unwrapped ego-minus-opponent progress is greater than zero.
classification_contract.termination_rule: Stop on any-agent collision, environment done, or 8.0 seconds, matching demonstration.py collision handling. Any collision is excluded from no-collision completion.

gate.rule: B-F0 passes iff at least 17 of 24 H0 scenarios finish without either vehicle colliding and are classified as overtake or clean follow.

opponent.raceline_and_speed_scale: Use each H0 scenario's opp_raceline and opp_speedscale.

run_contract.integrator: Use each H0 scenario's RK4 value.
run_contract.runtime_harness: Untracked one-shot orchestration only; reuse demonstration.py setup functions and existing environment/progress facilities; do not add an evaluator.

cluster_definition.component_rule: Connect two reproduced-collision cases when their collision-progress circular distance is at most 8.382485 m; use transitive connected components. A component with at least two cases is a cluster; a singleton is scatter.
cluster_definition.epsilon_derivation: Austin progress-reference track length 419.12425 m divided by the 50 canonical training startpoint sectors.
cluster_definition.not_reproduced_rule: A H0 case that did not reproduce ego collision in Phase 0 has no collision-progress coordinate and is classified as not_reproduced scatter.
cluster_definition.position_rule: For a reproduced collision, project the final saved ego pose from its existing Phase 0 trace. The evaluator omits the terminal post-step observation, so this is the last pre-terminal pose and no new replay is allowed for taxonomy.

decision_rule.clear_cluster_rule: CLEAR_CLUSTERED iff at least 12 of all 24 H0 cases belong to non-singleton circular components; otherwise COMPLETELY_SCATTERED.

focused_h1_scope_rule.clear_clustered: Keep all 24 H0 scenarios. For H1, project each H1 ego start and assign it to the nearest of the 50 canonical training startpoint progress anchors by circular distance, breaking ties by lower training ordinal. Select all H1 parameter variants assigned to any source H0 startpoint ordinal represented in a non-singleton collision cluster.
focused_h1_scope_rule.completely_scattered: Use all 24 H0 plus all 482 H1 scenarios.
focused_h1_scope_rule.selection_hash_rule: Hash compact canonical JSON rows with sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':') followed by one newline.

collision_and_retention.discard_rule: Discard an episode from the demonstration dataset if either vehicle collides, the environment terminates before 8.0 seconds, any required array is non-finite, or the episode does not contain exactly 80 samples. This is stricter than the guide's ego-collision exclusion and matches demonstration.py's any-agent collision handling.
collision_and_retention.report: Record attempted, retained, ego-collision, opponent-only-collision, incomplete, and error counts. No retention threshold is introduced by the guide, so all valid retained episodes proceed to the B2 record.

generator.reuse: Import demonstration.setup_ego_planner and demonstration.setup_opp_planner; reuse latticeplanner.utils.downsample_lidar and the existing F110 environment.

npz_schema.desired_speed: float32[T], ego planner desired speed applied during the sampled transition
npz_schema.lidar: float32[T,360], post-step ego scan downsampled with scan[::4][:360]
npz_schema.steer: float32[T], clipped ego steering applied during the sampled transition
npz_schema.train_py_alignment: For each 80-row episode, train.py uses lidar[1:], [steer,desired_speed][1:] as targets, and desired_speed[:-1] as previous desired-speed input. The NPZ preserves exactly those source columns; B3 must not silently change alignment.

original_bc_distribution_comparison.required_risk_rule: Compare median desired speed with the frozen original BC dataset and flag risk if absolute relative median difference exceeds 20 percent.
original_bc_distribution_comparison.unavailable_rule: If the frozen original dataset remains absent, record comparison as UNAVAILABLE_MISSING_FROZEN_DATA; do not fabricate a baseline and do not start B3.

sampling.integrator: Use each selected scenario's integrator field.
sampling.planner_replan_and_tracking: Match demonstration.py tracker_steps behavior for both planners.

downstream_contract.b1: Use the already completed Route A Phase 0 traces and the guide-defined tuple (collision type, track-segment cluster, opponent raceline, speed scale). Clustered failures select the corresponding H1 neighborhood; otherwise use all H0 plus H1.
downstream_contract.b2: Training-side H0/H1 only. Generate planner-ego demonstrations in the original BC input/action schema and discard every ego-collision episode before any BC fine-tuning.

b3_external_dependency.required_by_guide: Original frozen BC Task8 training data and its hash from the backup directory.
